name: pixa
display_name: PIXA — x402 Wallet for AI Agents (Sui)
description: Wallet for Claude. Check USDC balance and sign x402 payments on Sui — no API keys, no accounts.
long_description:
Give Claude a wallet on Sui. PIXA adds tools for:

- **check_balance** — View your USDC and SUI balance and wallet address
- **pay** — Sign an x402 payment authorization (Sui scheme — Phase 3)
- **x402_fetch** — Fetch a URL with automatic x402 payment handling
- **spending_report** — Audit what this session has spent
- **search_bazaar** — Discover x402-gated AI services

Budget limits protect your funds: set max per call and max per day.

sui_private_key.title: Sui Private Key
sui_private_key.description: Sui ed25519 private key (suiprivkey1... or raw bytes) used to sign x402 payments on Sui Testnet/Mainnet. Stored securely in your OS keychain.

max_per_call.title: Max USDC per Payment
max_per_call.description: Maximum USDC allowed per single payment. Safety limit.

max_per_day.title: Max USDC per Day
max_per_day.description: Maximum total USDC allowed per calendar day.

tools.name: check_balance
tools.description: Check USDC and SUI balance and wallet address on Sui.

tools.name: pay
tools.description: Sign an x402 USDC payment authorization. Returns the payment header value.

tools.name: x402_fetch
tools.description: Fetch a URL with automatic x402 payment. Handles 402 responses by signing a USDC payment and retrying with the payment header.

tools.name: spending_report
tools.description: Show this session's spending: today, this session, remaining budget, and recent payments.

tools.name: search_bazaar
tools.description: Search for x402-gated AI services that agents can autonomously pay for.
